activity_horizon.definition: max(inquiries.inquiry_at) in the frozen raw candidate package
activity_horizon.caveat: Raw extraction timestamp is absent; this is a conservative activity-horizon proxy, not a claimed extraction time.

primary_target.grain: one label per lead at the deterministic first inquiry
primary_target.score_time: minimum inquiries.inquiry_at for lead_id; if tied, minimum inquiry_id is deterministic metadata tie-breaker
primary_target.scoring_instant: immediately after first inquiry is persisted and before broker response is known
primary_target.estimand: P(first inquiry eventually has broker_response == 'scheduled_visit' | information known at T1 score_time)
primary_target.negative_label: first inquiry has a non-null broker_response different from 'scheduled_visit'
primary_target.maturity_semantics: The 14-day buffer approximates label finality only. It does NOT mean the visit was scheduled within 14 days.
primary_target.product_question: Will this first inquiry eventually be recorded as scheduled_visit?
interpretation_limitations: does not credit a later inquiry that eventually becomes scheduled_visit
actual response resolution timestamp is absent for some rows
maturity relies on an activity-horizon proxy because extraction time is absent

B.estimand: P(a reconstructable scheduled_visit response event occurs in (T1 score_time, T1 score_time + 30d])
B.rejection_reason: The target claims event timing that raw data cannot identify for all scheduled_visit rows; additional maturity does not repair missing event timestamps.

C.estimand: P(an inquiry initiated in [T1 score_time, T1 score_time + 30d] eventually has broker_response == 'scheduled_visit')
C.important_semantic_guardrail: A positive does NOT imply the visit was scheduled inside 30 days; only the successful inquiry was initiated inside the 30-day window.
C.maturity_rule: score_time + 30-day inquiry window + 14-day maturity buffer <= activity_horizon
C.nonselection_reason: It measures future lead progress across later inquiries, not the outcome of the current first inquiry; later interactions and operational actions can create the positive label.

maturity_bakeoff.rationale_for_14: All 15,392 realized accepted/rejected/scheduled_visit rows with numeric timing resolve within 108.9 hours (<7 days), but untimed rows remain. Fourteen days adds a conservative margin at only 0.82 percentage points less cohort coverage than 7 days; 30 days gives no material prevalence-stability benefit and costs more coverage.

T0.estimand: P(at least one inquiry initiated in [lead.created_at, lead.created_at + 30d] eventually has broker_response == 'scheduled_visit' | T0 information)

T2.estimand: P(current T2 inquiry eventually has broker_response == 'scheduled_visit' | valid T2 information set and stage membership)
T2.reason: Population is conditional on reaching T2 and on no prior known scheduled visit. Historical T2 stage membership cannot yet be fully reconstructed when prior scheduled_visit timing is missing; cohort construction is deferred to the point-in-time ABT gate.

outcome_fields.rule: Outcome fields may be read only inside target/audit construction. They must never enter the scoring information set or feature matrices.

freeze_policy.required_process_for_change: Create a new target contract version, rerun the non-model bake-off, document the estimand change, and never back-select based on model Lift/AUC/AP.

spot_attributes.impact_on_target_selection: NONE; target labels do not depend on spot_attributes
